title: Savory Scottish Haggis Dumplings
description: A unique fusion of traditional Scottish haggis and Chinese dumplings, perfect for a flavorful and filling meal.
instructions: Combine haggis, all-purpose flour, and shortbread crumbs in a mixing bowl.
Gradually add water and mix until a dough forms. Knead for 5 minutes.
Divide the dough into 12-15 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a small spoonful of haggis mixture in the center of each circle.
Dip your finger in water and run it along the edge of the dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape, pressing edges to seal.
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook dumplings for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve hot with mellow soy sauce for dipping.
